dashboard.label: Overview
dashboard.description: Content imported into this Splunk deployment. Figures come from the local catalogue, not from the remote provider.

search.query: | inputlookup ucm_catalog_lookup where provider_status="active" | stats count
| inputlookup ucm_categories_lookup | where imported_count>0 | stats count
| inputlookup ucm_sync_state_lookup where doc_type="provider_state" | eval version=coalesce(last_good_version, "none imported") | table version
| inputlookup ucm_sync_state_lookup where doc_type="provider_state" | eval last=coalesce(last_success_at, "never") | table last
| inputlookup ucm_catalog_lookup where provider_status="active" | stats count by domains | sort - count | rename domains as domain
| inputlookup ucm_catalog_lookup where provider_status="active" | stats count by criticality criticality_rank | sort - criticality_rank | fields criticality count

html.div: Not assessed. Readiness, validation and deployment figures are shown only once environment discovery and readiness assessment have run against this deployment. No use case is reported as ready, validated or enabled until there is evidence for it.

search.query: | inputlookup ucm_sync_state_lookup where doc_type="job" | sort - requested_at | head 10 | table requested_at source status requested_by provider_version source_ref finished_at
